\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{خبر} \fa{فوری} (khabar-e fowri)}{خبر فوری (khabar-e fowri)}]{\fa{خبر} \fa{فوری} (khabar-e fowri) — breaking news}

\label{lesson:FA-C315-khabar-e-fowri}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to hold, then the Persian for to take part.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{خبر} \fa{فوری}}
\textbf{\fa{خبر} \fa{فوری}} (\emph{khabar-e fowri}) — \textquotedblleft{}breaking news\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تلویزیون} \fa{یک} \fa{خبر} \fa{فوری} \fa{پخش} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Televiziyon yek khabar-e fowri pakhsh kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The television broadcast a piece of breaking news.
\end{quote}

\emph{fowri} \textquotedblleft{}urgent\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{fowr} \textquotedblleft{}at once\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{khabar} \textquotedblleft{}news\textquotedblright{} is borrowed from Arabic \emph{khabar} (EtymDB); \emph{fowri} \textquotedblleft{}urgent\textquotedblright{} adds the Persian \emph{-i} to \emph{fowr} \textquotedblleft{}at once\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Arabic \emph{fawr}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khabar-e fowri}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khabar-e fowri}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{khabar-e fowri}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to hold, then the Persian for to take part, then say \emph{khabar-e fowri} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{خبر} \fa{فوری} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Breaking news\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار} (ruznâme negâr)}{روزنامه نگار (ruznâme negâr)}]{\fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار} (ruznâme negâr) — a journalist}

\label{lesson:FA-C315-ruzname-negar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to take part, then the Persian for breaking news.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار}}
\textbf{\fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار}} (\emph{ruznâme negâr}) — \textquotedblleft{}a journalist\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{بیست} \fa{سال} \fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{U bist sâl ruznâme negâr bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
She was a journalist for twenty years.
\end{quote}

\emph{ruznâme} \textquotedblleft{}newspaper\textquotedblright{} + \emph{negâr} \textquotedblleft{}one who writes or paints\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{negâshtan}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{ruznâme negâr} is built from Persian \emph{ruznâme} \textquotedblleft{}newspaper\textquotedblright{} (\emph{ruz} \textquotedblleft{}day\textquotedblright{} + \emph{nâme} \textquotedblleft{}letter\textquotedblright{}) and \emph{negâr-}, the stem of \emph{negâshtan} \textquotedblleft{}to write, to paint\textquotedblright{}. All of it is native.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ruznâme negâr}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ruznâme negâr}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{ruznâme negâr}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to take part, then the Persian for breaking news, then say \emph{ruznâme negâr} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A journalist\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{سرمقاله} (sarmaqâle)}{سرمقاله (sarmaqâle)}]{\fa{سرمقاله} (sarmaqâle) — an editorial, a leading article}

\label{lesson:FA-C315-sarmaqale}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for breaking news, then the Persian for a journalist.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{سرمقاله}}
\textbf{\fa{سرمقاله}} (\emph{sarmaqâle}) — \textquotedblleft{}an editorial, a leading article\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{سرمقاله} \fa{امروز} \fa{درباره} \fa{آموزش} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Sarmaqâle-ye emruz darbâre-ye âmuzesh bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Today's editorial was about education.
\end{quote}

\emph{sar} \textquotedblleft{}head\textquotedblright{} + \emph{maqâle} \textquotedblleft{}article\textquotedblright{}: the head article of the paper.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{sarmaqâle} joins native Persian \emph{sar} \textquotedblleft{}head\textquotedblright{} and \emph{maqâle} \textquotedblleft{}an article\textquotedblright{}, which is borrowed from Arabic \emph{maqāla}, \textquotedblleft{}article, essay\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sarmaqâle}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{sarmaqâle}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for breaking news, then the Persian for a journalist, then say \emph{sarmaqâle} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{تظاهرات} (tazâhorât)}{تظاهرات (tazâhorât)}]{\fa{تظاهرات} (tazâhorât) — a demonstration, a protest march}

\label{lesson:FA-C315-tazahorat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a journalist, then the Persian for an editorial.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{تظاهرات}}
\textbf{\fa{تظاهرات}} (\emph{tazâhorât}) — \textquotedblleft{}a demonstration, a protest march\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دیروز} \fa{جلوی} \fa{دانشگاه} \fa{تظاهرات} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Diruz jelo-ye dâneshgâh tazâhorât bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Yesterday there was a demonstration outside the university.
\end{quote}

Plural in form, but one event. Built on Arabic \emph{taẓāhur} \textquotedblleft{}a public show\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{tazâhorât} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{taẓāhurāt}, the plural of \emph{taẓāhur} \textquotedblleft{}a public show\textquotedblright{}; EtymDB lists no entry.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tazâhorât}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tazâhorât}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{tazâhorât}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a journalist, then the Persian for an editorial, then say \emph{tazâhorât} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شعار} (sho'âr)}{شعار (sho'âr)}]{\fa{شعار} (sho'âr) — a slogan, a chant}

\label{lesson:FA-C315-shoar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for an editorial, then the Persian for a demonstration.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شعار}}
\textbf{\fa{شعار}} (\emph{sho'âr}) — \textquotedblleft{}a slogan, a chant\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{مردم} \fa{در} \fa{خیابان} \fa{شعار} \fa{میدادند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Mardom dar khiyâbân sho'âr midâdand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
People were chanting slogans in the street.
\end{quote}

With \emph{dâdan}: \emph{sho'âr dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to chant slogans\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{sho'âr} is borrowed from Arabic \emph{shi'ār} (EtymDB lists the Arabic word), usually glossed \textquotedblleft{}a sign, a motto\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 308–315 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R315-review-308-315}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\raggedright

  \item to refute, to confirm, to follow up, to let someone know, to inform

  \item to publish, to broadcast, a newsreader, a viewer, news coverage
  \item statistics, to estimate, to stress, a summary, to summarise

A news agency? (\textbf{\fa{خبرگزاری}}.) To publish? (\textbf{\fa{منتشر} \fa{کردن}}.) To broadcast? (\textbf{\fa{پخش} \fa{کردن}}.) A newsreader? (\textbf{\fa{گوینده}}.) A viewer? (\textbf{\fa{بیننده}}.) News coverage? (\textbf{\fa{پوشش} \fa{خبری}}.) Statistics? (\textbf{\fa{آمار}}.) To estimate? (\textbf{\fa{برآورد} \fa{کردن}}.) To stress? (\textbf{\fa{تاکید} \fa{کردن}}.) To hold? (\textbf{\fa{برگزار} \fa{کردن}}.) To take part? (\textbf{\fa{شرکت} \fa{کردن}}.) Breaking news? (\textbf{\fa{خبر} \fa{فوری}}.) A journalist? (\textbf{\fa{روزنامه} \fa{نگار}}.) An editorial?
